topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, imagine running into Ms. Rahman again after all these years, and finding out that she's not just my old teacher but also my daughter's! I remember her classroom, always buzzing with activity, the way she could pull us into the world of stories and facts like no one else. Stepping into the parent-teacher conference, I felt a rush of memories. Here I am, sitting where my parents once did, and now it's about my little one. Ms. Rahman greeted me with a smile, the same warm smile I remember from back then. I can hardly believe the circle that's come around, and I'm more than a little curious to see how my daughter will bloom under her guidance.
